question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**highest**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage mentions Nanga Parbat, which is known as the world’s ninth peak in terms of elevation.
 
• The most appropriate adjective to describe a mountain peak in this context is "**highest**" because peaks are measured by height. (सबसे ऊँचा)
 
• Other options like "deepest," "lengthiest," and "fattest" are not suitable for describing mountains.
 
• Thus, the correct completion is "**the world’s ninth highest peak**."

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Deepest** (सबसे गहरा): Refers to depth, suitable for oceans or valleys, not mountain peaks.

 
 
• **Example:** The Mariana Trench is the deepest part of the world’s oceans.
 
 
 
• **Lengthiest** (सबसे लंबा): Refers to length, more appropriate for rivers or roads.
 
 
• **Example:** The Nile is considered the lengthiest river in the world.
 
 
 
• **Fattest** (सबसे मोटा): Refers to width or body fat, irrelevant in the context of mountains.
 
 
• **Example:** This is the fattest pumpkin in the competition.
